Beetroot hummus: roasted beetroot blended with chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic, swirled in a bowl, served with crackers.
M: the hermit pours hot soup into the monster's lap

A big pot of chicken and vegetable soup with shredded thigh meat, egg noodles, dill and lemon, ladled out hot with crusty bread. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 2L chicken stock with 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, diced, and 2 bay leaves for 45 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 150g egg noodles and cook 6 minutes. Season with salt, pepper and the juice of half a lemon, and stir in chopped dill. Serve hot with crusty bread.
Beef and paprika goulash over buttered noodles with sour cream
Beef chuck browned, onions cooked down slowly, sweet paprika, caraway and tomato, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Buttered egg noodles and sour cream.
W: Chocolate cupcakes with chocolate swirls and white chocolate brim hats
Chocolate cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, a tall swirl of chocolate buttercream and a white chocolate disc as a hat brim.
K: Warm honey vanilla milk with cinnamon and brandy, nutmeg on top

Hot milk whisked with honey, vanilla and cinnamon until frothy, spiked with brandy and dusted with nutmeg, the two offers in one mug. Warm 800ml full cream milk with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract until steaming, without boiling. Rest 5 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Whisk hard until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, add 30ml brandy to each and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the brandy for the warm milk crowd.

s.note: Cheddar, gouda and Swiss on a dark board with rye crispbread.
s.how: Cut 120g vintage cheddar, 120g gouda and 120g Swiss cheese into rough chunks on a dark wooden board. Add 1 pack rye crispbread, a jar of pickled onions and a pot of grainy mustard. Leave out 20 minutes before serving so the cheese softens.

s.note: Swirled beetroot hummus with tahini, lemon and garlic, with crackers.
s.how: Wrap 2 beetroots in foil and roast at 200C for 1 hour, then peel. Blitz with a drained 400g tin chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and 3 tbsp water until smooth. Swirl into a bowl and serve with 150g crackers.

m.note: Slow beef goulash with paprika and caraway, on buttered noodles with sour cream.
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 3 sliced brown onions slowly for 20 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp sweet paprika and 1 tsp caraway seeds, then add 400g crushed tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 400g buttered egg noodles with 150g sour cream.

w.note: Chocolate cupcakes in tall buttercream top hats.
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 170g self-raising flour, 30g cocoa and 100ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat 150g butter, 250g icing sugar and 30g cocoa and pipe a tall swirl on each. Melt 100g white chocolate into 12 thin discs, set, and sit one under each swirl as a hat brim.
